signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own the roadmap for critical portions of the Blackbird platform and product experience end-to-end, from strategy and prioritization through execution and launch
Define and drive the product vision for features that balance speed, quality, and scale across both our restaurant-facing and consumer-facing experiences
Partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to ship high-quality product at a pace that keeps us ahead of the market
Deeply understand our users, including restaurant operators, servers, and diners, through research, data analysis, and time spent in the field
Translate complex operational and technical constraints into elegant, user-centered product solutions
